title: Reconstructing an outline from distances (msdfgen)
description: MSDFgen computes a multichannel signed distance field of an original concave outline at three resolutions. Median-channel thresholding reconstructs its filled shape.
description_ko: MSDFgen으로 직접 만든 오목 윤곽의 다중 채널 부호 거리장을 세 해상도에서 계산했어요. 채널 중앙값을 기준으로 내부를 복원해요.
prompt: Reconstructing an outline from distances. Rerun the included recipe to change inputs.
made_with: Original native source at a pinned commit; C/C++ compilation executed locally on macOS arm64
summary: MSDFgen computes a multichannel signed distance field of an original concave outline at three resolutions.
summary_ko: MSDFgen으로 직접 만든 오목 윤곽의 다중 채널 부호 거리장을 세 해상도에서 계산했어요. 채널 중앙값을 기준으로 내부를 복원해요.
tool_about: MSDFgen computes a multichannel signed distance field of an original concave outline at three resolutions. Median-channel thresholding reconstructs its filled shape. The recipe compiles and runs the original engine.
